summary: Move-learning cleanup pressed through an Endless Candy target layer
symptom: Resolving Sandile's level-13 Snarl prompt acknowledged the replacement, then cleanup crossed an unknown field mode 21 target/task boundary and consumed additional Endless Candy uses. Sandile advanced unintentionally to level 16 and reached a Bulldoze learning prompt.

authoritative_evidence.text: However, Sandile already knows four moves.
authoritative_evidence.unintended_resource_use: more than one Candy after the requested Snarl replacement

root_cause: Cleanup used generic text-printer readiness and did not treat unknown field mode 21 as an input-owner boundary. The reusable target layer can expose a new printer while still accepting A.
fix: After the requested party move tuple changes, acknowledge only explicit Poof/forgot/And/learned pages; stop A immediately at any other page and use B-only layer cleanup. Abort if a nested move-learning prompt appears.
recovery: Loaded the newest verified forward checkpoint because the live corruption was caused by the tooling boundary, then verified Sandile level 10 and moves [43, 644, 317, 44] from RAM.

regression.required_live_case: One Candy use and one explicit replacement must return overworld with exactly one level increment and no pending move-learning UI.
